```sql
-- Migration: Split full_name into first_name and last_name (idempotent)

BEGIN;

-- Add new columns (safe if run multiple times)
ALTER TABLE users
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_name VARCHAR(255),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_name VARCHAR(255);

-- Backfill: split on first space
UPDATE users
SET 
  first_name = TRIM(SPLIT_PART(full_name, ' ', 1)),
  last_name = TRIM(SUBSTRING(full_name FROM POSITION(' ' IN full_name) + 1))
WHERE first_name IS NULL AND full_name IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
```

**Why this works:** `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` is idempotent; `WHERE first_name IS NULL` ensures the UPDATE skips already-migrated rows on re-run, making the script safely repeatable. Handles NULL full_name values, single-word names (last_name becomes empty), and multi-word names (everything after first space).

**To drop old column later** (separate, safer migration):
```sql
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS full_name;
```
